## 12-Week Spanish Path from A1 to A2

A realistic 12-week plan for a busy full-time employee: short weekday sessions, one longer Saturday session, and steady review so you build usable Spanish for travel, food, and basic work introductions.

## Weekly Study Plan

| Week | Focus | Weekday Plan (45 min) | Saturday Plan (2 hrs) | Weekly Goal |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Core survival Spanish | App lesson; 15 flashcards; 10 min pronunciation | Basic greetings, alphabet, numbers, countries | Introduce yourself and greet politely |
| 2 | Personal details | App lesson; vocabulary review; short reading | Name, nationality, job, email, phone number | Share simple personal info |
| 3 | Travel basics | App lesson; travel phrases; listening practice | Directions, transport, hotel check-in words | Ask for help and understand simple travel phrases |
| 4 | Food ordering 1 | App lesson; food flashcards; listening | Restaurant menu words, polite ordering, preferences | Order a meal and ask for recommendations |
| 5 | Food ordering 2 | App lesson; review; short reading | Allergies, drinks, paying, takeaway phrases | Handle a simple restaurant interaction |
| 6 | Daily routines | App lesson; verbs; flashcards | Present tense of common verbs; daily routine speaking | Describe your day in simple sentences |
| 7 | Work introductions | App lesson; job vocabulary; reading | Introduce yourself at work, roles, meetings, schedules | Give a basic work introduction |
| 8 | Travel conversations 2 | App lesson; listening; review deck | Airport, train station, taxi, check-in, asking questions | Manage common travel situations |
| 9 | Past and future basics | App lesson; verb patterns; flashcards | Very simple past/future phrases for plans and experiences | Talk about what you did and will do |
| 10 | Work + travel roleplay | App lesson; speaking prompts; reading | Roleplay: coworker intro, hotel, restaurant, directions | Combine topics in short conversations |
| 11 | A2 consolidation | App lesson; mixed review; listening | Longer reading, speaking drills, weak-area repair | Increase speed and confidence |
| 12 | Final review and test week | Light app review; flashcards; speaking | Full mock review: travel, food, work introductions | Hold 2–3 minute basic conversations |

## Weekly Review Rhythm

Use the same structure every week so the habit stays easy.

- Monday: new app lesson + 10-minute flashcard review
- Tuesday: vocabulary review + 1 short listening clip
- Wednesday: reading practice + note 5 useful phrases
- Thursday: speaking practice out loud for 10–15 minutes
- Friday: mixed review of the week’s material
- Saturday: longer practice block, roleplay, and one mini test
- Sunday: rest or very light recap if needed

## Daily Study Template

Keep weekday sessions simple and repeatable.

- 15 min: app lesson or guided grammar practice
- 15 min: flashcards with spaced repetition
- 10 min: reading or listening
- 5 min: speaking aloud or shadowing
- 0–5 min: quick notes on mistakes

## Progress Checklist

Use this checklist at the end of each week.

- I can understand and use this week’s target vocabulary.
- I can say the main phrases without reading every word.
- I reviewed flashcards on at least 4 weekdays.
- I completed one speaking session aloud.
- I understood at least one short reading or audio item.
- I can do the week’s target task: travel, food, or work intro.
- I noted my 3 weakest words or grammar points.
- I am ready to move to the next week’s topic.

## Recommended Tool Mix

- **Apps:** one main app for structured lessons and one backup for quick review
- **Flashcards:** use spaced repetition for travel, food, and work phrases
- **Reading:** short beginner dialogues, menus, signs, and workplace intros
- **Speaking:** self-talk, shadowing, and roleplay with prompts or language exchange

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Start with flashcards](https://quizlet.com/)
Action: [Button: Practice Spanish lessons](https://www.duolingo.com/)
Action: [Button: Get beginner reading](https://www.lingq.com/)
Action: [Button: Find speaking partners](https://www.tandem.net/)

## Sources

- Spanish proficiency overview: https://www.coe.int/en/web/common-european-framework-reference-languages
- Beginner Spanish learning support: https://www.duolingo.com/
- Flashcard spaced repetition: https://quizlet.com/
